notes: Single standalone structure, no arrow and no reagent label. It is the structural formula of tembotrione itself, announced by [0007] and captioned "Formula 1" below the drawing. presented_as is set to intermediate_structure because that is the schema's only value for a standalone structure; the honest description is that this is an identity drawing of the compound the invention purifies, printed in the background section, and it is NOT an intermediate of any route and NOT a prior-art route. Ring numbering above is read off the drawing geometry: C1 is the benzene vertex bonded to the bridging carbonyl, and the four substituted benzene vertices are CONSECUTIVE (attachment, then Cl, then CH2OCH2CF3, then SO2CH3), leaving the remaining two vertices bare. Verified at 3x magnification: the Cl label sits directly above the vertex adjacent to the attachment vertex, the CH2OCH2CF3 chain leaves the next vertex clockwise, and the SO2CH3 label leaves the vertex below that. Both ketones of the carbocycle are drawn as explicit C=O, one up-left and one down-right, each one bond from the substituted C2, so it is the 1,3-dione.

PRESENTED AS PRIOR ART, not as the invention's route, on four grounds: the drawing sits inside the background section, whose heading is printed above [0002] with no later heading before it anywhere on this page; [0009] introduces it as how the preparation of tembotrione is done, not as anything the applicant proposes; the invention itself is stated in the title and in [0001] to be a purification / impurity-reduction method rather than a preparation route; and [0011], immediately after the drawing, treats this route's output as the problem to be solved, since it leaves acetone cyanohydrin behind. Layout: two rows, read left to right then down. Row 1 carries the acid, the first arrow, the enol ester and the second arrow; row 2 carries the final product alone. The 2nd and 4th structures are reagents sitting off the reaction line rather than members of the main chain; they are recorded in the structures array so their connectivity is not lost, with their arrow roles given in the arrows array.

notes: One scheme, two arrows, read left to right and then wrapping to the second row. The second arrow points into blank space at the right edge of the top row and the product it leads to is drawn at the left of the second row, so that wrap is a layout continuation and not a third structure. Nothing is drawn below the second arrow, and the label SOCl2 above the first arrow is the only thing written anywhere on the scheme; both reagent molecules are drawn as structures. No solvent, base, temperature, time or yield appears on the drawing. It is presented as the invention's route, not as prior art: it stands inside the embodiments section, is announced at [0028] as the synthesis scheme and at [0030] by the sentence saying its synthesis reaction formula is shown below, where the possessive refers to the invention just described, and its final structure is the tembotrione product that the whole patent purifies. The prior art discussion sits earlier, on p03 and p04, and carries no drawing of its own. Ring positions on both benzene rings were read off the drawing, going round from the carbonyl-bearing carbon, and were not inferred from the compound's identity.
